summary: Implementation plan for the complete Advanced System Analysis suite, featuring an interactive 2D Efficiency Map with IEC 60034-1 / WLTP drive cycle modeling, an active material BOM mass and cost synthesizer, a dynamic lumped-parameter transient thermal duty-cycle simulator (S1-S9), and a comprehensive engineering export suite (AutoCAD DXF, CSV, JSON, and PDF design documentation), organized into a dedicated System Analysis tab.
